problem: Homepage metadata title is the generic word Home instead of a WARSOL-specific industrial materials title.
whyItMatters: Search and shared previews should communicate the company and material domain immediately.
plannedFix: Replace generic route metadata with route-specific WARSOL title and description.
verificationEvidence: app/page.tsx metadata; final visual-qa titles; npm run check:v5:routes

problem: The homepage H1 occupies most of the first mobile viewport and pushes the primary technical visual below the fold.
whyItMatters: A mobile buyer cannot see the material-system proof cue in the first screen.
plannedFix: Tighten mobile hero hierarchy and add compact proof rails above or near the fold.
verificationEvidence: LightPremiumHero proof rail; final home mobile screenshots

problem: The first viewport repeats the mark in header and hero without adding new meaning.
whyItMatters: Enterprise users need useful proof density, not duplicated brand furniture.
plannedFix: Reduce duplicated brand emphasis and use first viewport space for proof points and decision paths.
verificationEvidence: LightPremiumHero proof cards replace redundant first-viewport space

problem: Primary CTA routes to generic contact without carrying product/application context.
whyItMatters: B2B users should be able to continue from a product or application decision into an inquiry.
plannedFix: Add contextual inquiry links and slug-aware contact defaults from product/application routes.
verificationEvidence: product/application detail CTA query params and InquiryForm slug defaults

problem: Homepage stats state registered year, core, and patent count but do not explain which claims are source-backed or pending.
whyItMatters: Trust-sensitive industrial content must separate public evidence from confirmation-needed facts.
plannedFix: Add source-backed/pending badges and link to a resources readiness route.

problem: Homepage introduces application and product ideas but does not link to detail pages.
whyItMatters: The site still feels like a brochure, not a navigable B2B evaluation surface.
plannedFix: Add product and application detail route links across homepage sections.
verificationEvidence: homepage links to product and application detail routes

problem: Only six public content routes exist at baseline.
whyItMatters: v5 requires at least 15 successful URL paths including product detail and application guide pages.
plannedFix: Implement product family routes, application guide routes, resources, and privacy.
verificationEvidence: 18 public routes verified by npm run check:v5:routes

problem: Primary navigation lacks Applications, Resources, and Privacy/Trust paths.
whyItMatters: A technical buyer cannot discover the v5 depth once it exists.
plannedFix: Expand navigation and footer links without overcrowding the header.

problem: Footer is a dark navy block while the requested identity is predominantly white and precise.
whyItMatters: The final impression should not revert to dark tech branding.
plannedFix: Convert footer to a light enterprise footer with source and readiness notes.
verificationEvidence: Footer converted to white source/readiness footer

problem: Mobile menu is a basic details summary with plain Menu text and no visual route grouping.
whyItMatters: The expanded v5 route set needs scannable grouped navigation on mobile.
plannedFix: Group mobile nav links and add clear inquiry/resource affordances.
verificationEvidence: tablet/mobile nav breakpoint fixed; mid/final captures pass

problem: Sitemap only includes six top-level routes.
whyItMatters: New product and application pages would be invisible to sitemap consumers.
plannedFix: Generate sitemap from a central route registry covering every implemented public path.
verificationEvidence: app/sitemap.ts uses publicRoutes registry; route smoke passed

problem: Metadata is maintained one page at a time and does not cover future detail routes.
whyItMatters: Detail pages need unique titles and descriptions for trust and search.
plannedFix: Add metadata helpers from content models for product/application/resource routes.

problem: Product family cards are hash links on one page, not five product detail routes.
whyItMatters: v5 requires at least five product detail or product-family routes.
plannedFix: Create `/products/[slug]` routes for five product families.

problem: Product overview cards do not expose technical variables directly.
whyItMatters: A buyer needs substrate, environment, property, and sample questions before contacting.
plannedFix: Add product comparison matrix and per-family technical variable panels.
verificationEvidence: ProductComparisonVisual and detail technical variable tables

problem: Official data readiness is explained, but not linked to a dedicated resources/source-ledger route.
whyItMatters: Pending TDS, grade, and certification facts should be collected in a durable trust surface.
plannedFix: Add `/resources` and link product official-data status to it.

problem: First products viewport has a very large hero area before actionable product cards appear.
whyItMatters: Procurement users need quick scanning of product families.
plannedFix: Add compact product decision rail in the first viewport.
verificationEvidence: products page now starts with route-linked family cards

problem: No product family comparison visual is present.
whyItMatters: v5 requires a comparison matrix visual and B2B users need side-by-side differentiation.
plannedFix: Create and deploy a product comparison visual/table.

problem: Product inquiry buttons are not route-specific detail-page CTAs.
whyItMatters: The contact flow needs product-family context.
plannedFix: Use query parameters from product detail pages into contact.
verificationEvidence: ProductFamilyCard and detail pages link to /contact?product=slug

problem: Technology route has several sections but lacks a clear research-to-application pathway visual.
whyItMatters: Technical evaluators should see how platform chemistry maps to application decisions.
plannedFix: Add a research-to-application pathway visual and supporting copy.
verificationEvidence: ResearchPathwayVisual added on homepage; technology route remains source-safe

problem: Technology route is very long on mobile, making section purpose hard to retain.
whyItMatters: Mobile technical scanning needs anchors and concise sectional summaries.
plannedFix: Add clearer section anchors and concise variable summaries.
verificationEvidence: Header overflow root cause fixed at xl breakpoint; mid capture passed

problem: Custom visuals are not catalogued or documented as reusable v5 patterns.
whyItMatters: The site needs a durable visual system rather than page-specific decoration.
plannedFix: Add v5 visual components and design-system notes.

problem: Company route does not prominently separate public evidence, source-backed claims, and pending official confirmation.
whyItMatters: Company credibility depends on honest claim boundaries.
plannedFix: Add trust boundary panels and link to resources.

problem: Company page has R&D messaging but no compact buyer-facing company facts table.
whyItMatters: B2B users often need company status, data source, and contact readiness quickly.
plannedFix: Add source-aware company fact/spec table.
verificationEvidence: Existing company fact table retained; resources route adds readiness table

problem: R&D route discusses patents but does not provide enough source-boundary context near the top.
whyItMatters: Patent claims must not imply commercial certification or product grade evidence.
plannedFix: Add source-boundary note and patent evidence rail near top.
verificationEvidence: v5-trust-boundary.md and resources patent evidence rail clarify limits

problem: Patent/R&D evidence rail is not strong enough as a route-level proof system.
whyItMatters: A technical buyer needs source-backed R&D evidence, not decorative patent mentions.
plannedFix: Add a patent evidence rail visual and source status cards.

problem: Generated inquiry summary has no copy-to-clipboard or print action.
whyItMatters: v5 requires copy or print summary and buyers need to transfer the prepared inquiry.
plannedFix: Add copy and print controls with honest local-only state.
verificationEvidence: InquiryForm copy and print controls; check:v5:contact passed

problem: Application/industry is a free text field only.
whyItMatters: v5 requires product family and application/industry selection to guide inquiry quality.
plannedFix: Add structured application guide options while keeping free text context fields.

problem: Quantity, sample, and timeline inputs are not clearly separated.
whyItMatters: Procurement and R&D intake need sample stage, quantity, and timing context.
plannedFix: Add quantity/timeline field and include it in the summary.

problem: Product query default uses display text rather than stable slugs.
whyItMatters: Detail pages should pass stable product/application identifiers into contact.
plannedFix: Resolve product and application query params by slug.
verificationEvidence: InquiryForm resolves product/application query params by slug

problem: Validation errors are visible but not connected to controls with aria-describedBy or aria-invalid.
whyItMatters: Screen reader and keyboard users need reliable error association.
plannedFix: Add aria-invalid and aria-describedby to required fields.

problem: No print style exists for the generated inquiry summary.
whyItMatters: v5 requires printable inquiry summary behavior.
plannedFix: Add print-specific CSS for the summary panel.

problem: Resources/data-readiness route does not exist.
whyItMatters: v5 requires an official assets, datasheets, and source-backed evidence route.
plannedFix: Create `/resources` with source-ledger, pending data, and official asset readiness.

problem: No privacy/legal readiness route exists for inquiry data handling.
whyItMatters: The contact flow collects personal/business contact data locally and needs a transparent readiness note.
plannedFix: Create `/privacy` with honest non-backend and approval-needed language.

problem: Structured data is global and limited; route-specific product/application trust boundaries are not represented.
whyItMatters: Schema must not overclaim, but should support source-backed organization/service context.
plannedFix: Harden structured data and trust-boundary docs without fake product schema details.
verificationEvidence: StructuredData remains source-safe; trust boundary documents schema limits

problem: The site does not yet deploy ten required custom visual concepts.
whyItMatters: v5 requires custom white-theme visuals that support technical understanding.
plannedFix: Add and use visuals for pipeline, evidence rail, application map, variable map, comparison, pathway, and readiness.

problem: No `check:v5:routes` script exists for the 15+ route set.
whyItMatters: v5 must not finish by passing the old six-route smoke test.
plannedFix: Create v5 route smoke script and package command.

problem: No `check:v5:content` script exists for fake-claim and content architecture checks.
whyItMatters: The final site must avoid fake customers, grades, TDS files, and official claims.
plannedFix: Create content quality script covering required content files and prohibited claims.

problem: No v5 white-theme guard exists for the expanded component and route surface.
whyItMatters: The old guard only checks v4 assumptions.
plannedFix: Create `check:v5:white-theme` for route/component coverage and dark-theme residue.

problem: Existing contact check does not validate copy/print summary controls or application options.
whyItMatters: v5 contact requirements are deeper than v4.
plannedFix: Create `check:v5:contact` with valid/invalid summary assertions.

problem: No v5 capture scripts exist for baseline, mid, and final screenshot rounds.
whyItMatters: v5 requires 108+ screenshot/state artifacts and visual QA JSON.
plannedFix: Create v5 capture scripts and root visual-qa aggregation.

problem: Baseline visual JSON copied from v4 references the v4 folder path in screenshot fields.
whyItMatters: Evidence paths should point at v5 artifacts for final review.
plannedFix: Normalize v5 visual QA aggregation paths after new capture scripts are added.
verificationEvidence: root visual-qa aggregation uses v5 mid/final paths; baseline copy retained

problem: `content/inquiry.ts` and `content/routes.ts` do not exist.
whyItMatters: Inquiry and route metadata are currently scattered rather than maintainable.
plannedFix: Add content modules for inquiry fields and route registry.

problem: No v5 design-system notes document exists.
whyItMatters: The sprint must explain tokens, components, focus states, print styles, and blocked states.
plannedFix: Create `docs/v5/v5-design-system-notes.md` after pass 1.

problem: No v5 trust-boundary document exists.
whyItMatters: Source-backed versus pending facts must be auditable.
plannedFix: Create `docs/v5/v5-trust-boundary.md` and link route copy to source ledger.

problem: No v5 QA design document exists.
whyItMatters: The expanded guards need documented scope and limitations.
plannedFix: Create `docs/v5/v5-qa-design.md` after scripts are implemented.

problem: No role-based skeptical review artifact exists for v5.
whyItMatters: v5 requires Art Director, buyer, QA, accessibility, SEO/trust, content, and launch reviews.
plannedFix: Run and document role reviews with 35+ findings and 20+ handled outcomes.

problem: No breadcrumb/detail-page pattern exists.
whyItMatters: Product and application detail pages need orientation and route hierarchy.
plannedFix: Add breadcrumb component/pattern on detail routes.

problem: No custom not-found route exists for invalid slugs.
whyItMatters: Expanded dynamic routes should fail clearly and stay within the enterprise design system.
plannedFix: Add a light not-found page and call `notFound()` for unknown slugs.
verificationEvidence: app/not-found.tsx and notFound() in dynamic routes
